comment: insight.c set_vanq_order() returns flags.vanq_sortmode when the player toggles the preselected row off and commits (n == 0); only ESC returns -1, which makes list_vanquished() skip the list. The port must reach the list. A debug Samurai creates a newt and a jackal with ^G (wizgenesis), slays both with #wizkill ('m' moves getpos to the next monster, '.' picks it, ESC ends), quits without dumping core, and answers 'a' at 'Do you want an account of creatures vanquished? [ynaq]' (disclose:yv asks it). The two kinds make list_vanquished() offer the sort menu. Segment 1 clears the preselected 'traditional' row with '-' (MENU_UNSELECT_ALL) and commits with Return; segment 2 toggles it off with its own selector 't', which ends the PICK_ONE menu with n == 0 too.
